description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only (Bailiff demo, route 7A): get a one-time loan code for the Atlas retrieval connector, which keeps the lent practice data only in folders you name on your own computer. The reply says whether take-back on your computer is on. Demonstration on a synthetic practice matter; not certified; binds only this practice copy.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.
